items.headline: Eight ADU permits issued across San José in one week
items.summary: The city issued building permits for eight accessory dwelling units between July 22–24, ranging from $96,756 to $171,698, spanning neighborhoods from 5th Street to Foxworthy Avenue to Prunetree Court. One permit at 247 N 34th St is listed for 2 units, more than the single-unit ADUs typical of the rest of the batch.

items.headline: Council to discuss three active lawsuits against Cupertino
items.summary: In closed session, the council was scheduled to confer with legal counsel on three pending lawsuits: Lixin (Leon) Chen, et al. v. City of Cupertino, Yes in My Backyard, et al. v. City of Cupertino, and Garden Gate Coalition for Mary Avenue Safety v. City of Cupertino, all filed in Santa Clara County Superior Court.
